$comment: Supported Foundry-Edge pairing. docs/compatibility.md is the human-readable record; scripts/supported-pairing.mjs reads and validates this file, CI starts the gateway edge.image names, and scripts/supported-pairing.test.mjs fails when any other file pins a different Ferrum Edge image. edge.release is the Edge release the next Foundry release pairs with; the release workflow refuses a tag until it is filled and edge.image equals it. Values beginning with RELEASE-STEP are filled by the release step, never guessed.

foundry.source_commit: RELEASE-STEP: the commit vX.Y.Z points to (also the image's org.opencontainers.image.revision label)
foundry.image: RELEASE-STEP: ferrumedge/ferrum-foundry@sha256:<multi-arch index digest from the release run>
foundry.ci_evidence: RELEASE-STEP: URL of the green CI run for the tagged commit

edge.build: published release v0.9.7 (https://github.com/ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge/releases/tag/v0.9.7), the Edge release Foundry v0.2.0 pairs with (edge.release). v0.9.6 was tagged but never published; v0.9.7 is the first published release after v0.9.5

requirements: It includes ferrum-edge#5661: a strong ETag on resource reads and If-Match on PUT/DELETE of proxies, upstreams, consumers, and plugin configs.

Its proxy-association and namespace-identity semantics are those Foundry's walkthrough and critical journeys assert: it attaches the proxy association when a proxy-scoped plugin config is written (ferrum-edge#4611) and keys proxies, upstreams, plugin configs, and API specs on (namespace, id) (ferrum-edge 5db1d77a8), as v0.9.5 (edge.image) does. scripts/starter-journey.mjs and e2e/journeys/namespace-isolation.spec.ts were aligned with those semantics in #409. A release that changes either must pass the gates unchanged in intent.

The full qualification is re-run with edge.image moved to that release, and every job is green on the pull request that moves it, before any Foundry release is published: Quality Gate, Pinned Gateway Contract (including capability parity, writable and read-only), Deployment Starter, Critical Journeys, and Container Gate.

gateway.admin_security: HS256 admin JWT with audience and FERRUM_ADMIN_REQUIRE_NAMESPACE_CLAIM=true

evidence: Pinned Gateway Contract (capability parity, read-only half)

tested.deployment: deploy/starter: Compose, nginx identity proxy with the shared group-to-role policy, production image

scale.real_gateway: demo seed and contract fixtures: tens of resources per namespace, two namespaces
scale.synthetic_request_budget: 500 and 50,000 records per collection (request counts and bytes only, src/api/dataLoadingBudget.test.ts)

best_effort: database mode on PostgreSQL or MySQL
other Chromium-based browsers, Firefox, and Safari
Kubernetes and other deployments that reproduce the documented trusted-proxy contract
not_qualified: file, dp, mesh, and node_agent gateway modes (modelled read-only in the UI, not run in CI)
any Ferrum Edge release other than v0.9.7 (edge.release), older or newer
any Ferrum Edge image other than edge.image, including the 0.9.7-ebpf and 0.9.7-ebpf-tools variants
browser latency and more than one concurrent operator at scale

edge_dependencies.what: strong ETag on resource reads and If-Match on PUT/DELETE of proxies, upstreams, consumers, and plugin configs; a malformed If-Match, or one on a route that does not evaluate it, is 400
edge_dependencies.status: released in Ferrum Edge v0.9.7 (edge.release and edge.image)
edge_dependencies.effect_on_pinned_edge: Foundry's write guard sends If-Match with the ETag of its verification read, so a writer that commits between that read and the write is refused with 412; the gateway contract asserts the 412s and the 400s

edge_dependencies.what: optional proxy_id filter on GET /plugins/config (exact match, paginated over the filtered set, invalid value is 400)
edge_dependencies.status: released in Ferrum Edge v0.9.7 (edge.release and edge.image)
edge_dependencies.effect_on_pinned_edge: a proxy's Plugins tab lists the proxy-scoped configurations targeting it from the filtered collection instead of the whole namespace; a response the filter did not narrow is refused rather than shown
